comment: Have you had any class, that you just want to get them over with asap? Most of the classes are like that.But, there are still some teachers and classes that actually worth the money that you spent.These are the classes that you dont want miss, and Dr.Wren's class is one of the top on that "Don't Miss" category. Sadly, next semester is his last

Great professor! He can be disorganized, but makes up for it with great discussions and clarity. Go to class discussions - it makes assignments so much easier. The grading and work expectations are fair. Take his classes!
Great teacher.  Can get pretty boring at times, but is an overall nice guy.  Not a very hard class with only three papers and a final.  Fair grader.
All mighty J. Thomas Wren. Great teacher. Encourages students to actively participate and engage in discussions. Grading standards are consistent and fair. Drinks A LOT of diet coke.

Judicial Leadership - Best FYS. Seems really boring in class but stick it out and it gets better. He takes you to dinner near the end of the semester and its impossible not to like him as a teacher. Pretty easy to get a B, a little more difficult to get an A but still not bad since you can rewrite papers and turn in other stuff whenever you gettoit

Judicial Leadership- he grades papers based on numbers, which is think is admirable.  he is deaf in one ear, which makes class discussions difficult at times.gives a grade for participation so have to talk.  class can get boring, but i think he's a good guy.  he tries to make the class interesting and different.  students lead discussion
